paragraphs: Rabbi Abba, father of Rabbi Abba bar Mari, in Rabbi Acha’s name; Jerusalem Talmud, Pe'ah, chapter 1. It appears to me that it should read “Abba, father of Rabbi Abba Mari.” So too it appears in Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, Haro'eh (the source prints ע׳): Rabbi Ba, father of Rabbi Ba Mari, in Rabbi Acha’s name.
